conventions.bootstrap: 0024's construction: 2000 cluster resamples of the scored chunks, numpy default_rng(20260917), rung accuracies rounded to 4 decimals inside each resample; ci95 = 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles rounded to 6 decimals
conventions.proxies: 0024's s4, r5 and r7 vectors stand in for 0026's k = 0, 1 and 3 at x = k; r5 and r7 still contain 0021's block, so they are proxies only
conventions.value: at the precision the brief writes it, rounded half up from the shortest decimal repr; value_full holds the unrounded reading

discrepancies_with_the_draft.note: floors were an allowance of about 50 s in the draft; the linear-in-rows estimate is 48 s, which moves the core and the cumulative totals by 2 s
the least-squares line through 0024's four per-iteration points is about 3.90 + 0.0000546 x rows, not the draft's 4.1 + 5.3e-5; the cases move by 39 to 82 s

discrepancies_with_the_draft.brief: 0.038916 (py_src), 0.000454, under 0.00016 per doubling; 1473 of 1488 chunks carry all 26 rows (38298 rows)
discrepancies_with_the_draft.note: the brief's 'under 0.00016 per doubling' divided the level by the 3 doublings spanned (0.000151); the largest OLS slope over k = {0, 1, 3} of a level confined to a band of that width is 5/14 of it, 0.000162, which is not under 0.00016
the unrounded components sum to 6.15 GB, which is 6.1 at one decimal; the draft's 6.2 summed the rounded components

cost_fit_seconds.basis: 0024's banked fit seconds by role and rows; the run's real seconds depend on iteration counts, which are not known in advance
cost_fit_seconds.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:loglog_seconds (piecewise-linear interpolation of log seconds on log fit rows over 0024's rungs 1..7, per role)
cost_fit_seconds.note: floors were an allowance of about 50 s in the draft; the linear-in-rows estimate is 48 s, which moves the core and the cumulative totals by 2 s
cost_fit_seconds.rule: clause and arm fits: per role, log-log interpolation at each fold's fit rows; null: 0024's null seconds x rows / 210751; reproduction: 0024's three s4 seconds summed; floors: 0021's three floor seconds (B-feat1 1.1 s, the other two 0.0 s) at 26346 rows, linear in rows over the 15 fold-rung fits; A1: 0021's block minus F; pair fold: the all-five rung minus py_src and rst_doc at k = 0 and 3
cost_fit_seconds.what: fit seconds per layer of the run, central estimate

cost_range_by_iterations.basis: assumes seconds per iteration are linear in rows, as at 0024's rungs 4..7
cost_range_by_iterations.function: numpy.polyfit (degree 1) on seconds / n_iter against n_fit_rows
cost_range_by_iterations.note: the least-squares line through 0024's four per-iteration points is about 3.90 + 0.0000546 x rows, not the draft's 4.1 + 5.3e-5; the cases move by 39 to 82 s
cost_range_by_iterations.rule: core minus the central k = 3 M4 seconds, plus n x sum over folds of (intercept + slope x fold rows); n = r6's 117, ceil(1.2 x r7's 153) = 184, and the cap 250
cost_range_by_iterations.what: core fit seconds when every k = 3 M4 fit runs n iterations, by a per-iteration rule fitted to 0024's rungs 4..7

fit_side.basis: one replicate reads the size of the fit-side variance; it does not bound it
fit_side.rule: sqrt(se^2 + sd^2 / Sxx), Sxx over x = {0, 1, 3}; the interval keeps the scored-side half-width
fit_side.what: slope dispersion and P(FLAT | true slope 0) if 0023's one-replicate difference (0.001) were the per-rung fit-side SD, independent across rungs

memory_peak.basis: 0024's anonymous RSS before its rung-7 block plus the arrays 0026 adds or drops; COULD NOT VERIFY until run
memory_peak.note: the unrounded components sum to 6.15 GB, which is 6.1 at one decimal; the draft's 6.2 summed the rounded components
memory_peak.rule: start - 260000 x 1108 x 4 B + realfit3 rows x 1108 x 4 B + fold rows x 1108 x 8 B + fold rows x 1108 x 4 B (GB = 1e9 B)
memory_peak.what: anonymous memory peak at the c_src k = 3 tree fit

wall_time.basis: 0024 scored 321409 rows per fit; 0026 scores 61409, so the ratio is an upper allowance
wall_time.what: wall seconds at most 0024's wall-to-fit ratio times the fit seconds

not_a_preregistration: 0026 is written and frozen only after 0025's run; nothing here is sealed, and the preregistration's pre-freeze check must recompute these with the runner's own code

fold_sizes.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:rung_sizes (counting over the manifests' chunk_ids_with_rows and rows_per_chunk)
fold_sizes.rule: all-five rung minus F's plaintexts and rows; scored sizes are the extension manifest's
fold_sizes.what: per held-out family F: seen plaintexts and fit rows at k = 0, 1, 3 (the all-five rung with F's rows deleted), and F's scored rows and chunks

k4_impossible.brief_value: c_src needs 384 and the pools hold 185 + 198 = 383
k4_impossible.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:rung_sizes (counting over the manifests' chunk_ids_with_rows and rows_per_chunk)
k4_impossible.note: every family is short at k = 4, not only c_src: c_src 384 against 383, pe_bin 3248 against 3176, py_src 10752 against 10522, rfc_txt 1440 against 1424, rst_doc 640 against 638
k4_impossible.rule: needed = 16 x base_chunks_with_rows_0021; in_pools = realfit2 chunks with rows + realfit3 new chunks with rows
k4_impossible.what: rung k = 4 needs 16 n_g plaintexts per family; the two pools hold fewer for every family

label_prior_bound.brief_value: 0.038916 (py_src), 0.000454, under 0.00016 per doubling; 1473 of 1488 chunks carry all 26 rows (38298 rows)
label_prior_bound.note: the brief's 'under 0.00016 per doubling' divided the level by the 3 doublings spanned (0.000151); the largest OLS slope over k = {0, 1, 3} of a level confined to a band of that width is 5/14 of it, 0.000162, which is not under 0.00016
label_prior_bound.rule: per family max_c count(y = c) / n_rows; level bound = max - 1/26; slope bound = level bound x the sum of the positive OLS weights (x - mean) / Sxx over x = {0, 1, 3}, i.e. 5/14 of it
label_prior_bound.what: largest per-family label frequency on the real rows, the level a prior-only rule can move, its bound per doubling over k = {0, 1, 3}, and the chunks that carry all 26 rows

oc_standard_error.what: standard error of T under the normal approximation: the real proxy's 95% half-width / 1.96

oob_vectors_aligned.rule: element-for-element equality of the two files' ext_chunk_ids, ext_fam and ext_families
oob_vectors_aligned.what: 0018's per-example vectors (oob_4096_scores.json) carry the same extension chunk ids and families, row for row, as 0024's

operating_characteristics.rule: segments between the rule's thresholds on T, each read by the rule at its midpoint
operating_characteristics.what: probability of each verdict at six true slopes: T ~ N(true, se), interval T -/+ half-width, the ordered rule of section 1

positive_control_lead_r7_model_minus_log.rule: paired over the real chunks with the slope bootstrap's resamples; compared with the banked point and ci95 for exact equality
positive_control_lead_r7_model_minus_log.what: reader positive control: 0024's lead of M4 over L3 at rung 7 on the real rows, recomputed

positive_control_model_slope_second_deca.rule: x = 0024's log2_chunks_second_decade; real-family rows; compared with the banked point and ci95 for exact equality
positive_control_model_slope_second_deca.what: reader positive control: 0024's model slope over rungs 4..7 on the 38452 real rows, recomputed from the banked vectors

proxy_one_fold_half_width.rule: one family's rows; chunk_ids = that family's chunks
proxy_one_fold_half_width.what: 95% half-width of one family's slope over {s4, r5, r7} at x = {0, 1, 3}, bootstrapped over that family's own chunks

proxy_real_s4_anchored_slope.what: s4-anchored in-distribution proxy: M4 slope over {s4, r5, r7} at x = {0, 1, 3} on the real rows (1488 chunks)

proxy_synthetic_s4_anchored_slope.rule: x = k; hexdump, sql and xml rows; half-width = (hi - lo) / 2
proxy_synthetic_s4_anchored_slope.what: s4-anchored pilot on the never-fitted synthetic families: M4 slope over {s4, r5, r7} at x = {0, 1, 3} (899 chunks)

proxy_two_rung_half_width.what: 95% half-width of the slope over {s4, r7} at x = {0, 3} only (the k = 1 cut), real and synthetic rows

real_s4_minus_r4.what: paired equal-count difference on the real rows: s4 (other projects) minus r4 (0021's block), M4

realfit3_share_of_k3_plaintexts.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:rung_sizes (counting over the manifests' chunk_ids_with_rows and rows_per_chunk)
realfit3_share_of_k3_plaintexts.rule: realfit3 positions used at k = 3 / plaintexts at k = 3
realfit3_share_of_k3_plaintexts.what: share of rung k = 3's plaintexts that come from realfit3

rotation_rows_ratio.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:rung_sizes (counting over the manifests' chunk_ids_with_rows and rows_per_chunk)
rotation_rows_ratio.rule: each family's rows are in four of the five folds
rotation_rows_ratio.what: sum over the five folds of fit rows, over the all-five rung's rows, per rung

rungs_all_five.function: tools/prereg_gen/0026/bank_design_numbers.py:rung_sizes (counting over the manifests' chunk_ids_with_rows and rows_per_chunk)
rungs_all_five.rule: per family g the first n_g * 2^k chunks with rows of realfit2's pool then realfit3's (chunk id ascending); rows summed from rows_per_chunk; k = 0 checked against 0024's s4 (rows per family and the sorted chunk-id digest)
rungs_all_five.what: 0026's all-five rungs k = 0, 1, 3: plaintexts, rows and realfit3 positions used, in total and per family

synthetic_first_decade_slope.what: pilot: M4 slope over 0024's rungs 1..4 on the synthetic rows

synthetic_r7_minus_0018_builder_model.rule: paired; 0018's vector is aligned row for row with 0024's (see checks)
synthetic_r7_minus_0018_builder_model.what: pilot: 0024's r7 M4 minus 0018's builder-fitted M4 on the synthetic rows

synthetic_s4_minus_r4.what: pilot: s4 minus r4 on the synthetic rows (other projects against the pinned files at equal count), M4

synthetic_second_decade_r4_anchored_slop.what: pilot: M4 slope over 0024's rungs 4..7 (0024's construction, r4-anchored) on the synthetic rows
